name: anonymous-placeholders
description: A diarized recording where no speaker is ever named. Three durable claims are said out loud, the extractor reads all three, and the ledger keeps none of them. fidelityRecall is 0 by design.
note: The anonymous-speaker gate nulls an entity that matches a diarizer label (facts-extract.ts:233) and its own comment says it 'drops the attribution but KEEPs the claim'. The write path then skips any fact with no entity (facts-extract.ts:508), so the claim is not kept at all. That gap is worth a number rather than a footnote: a single reject entry in drop-required says the gate fires, but only a fixture that is anonymous end to end shows what it costs. The gold entities are the subjects the claims are ABOUT, which is where a human would file them; the pipeline never gets that far, because it keys attribution off the speaker. The guard against this fixture being degenerately empty is report.factsSkipped: the claims must reach the write path and be dropped there, not fail to be extracted in the first place.
